public_rationale: Repeated illegal moves were documented experimentally and discussed publicly before the post. Successful games under other prompts do not negate that reputation. The evidence supports a recognized weakness, not an assertion that ChatGPT always makes illegal moves.
limitations: Failure rates depend on model version and prompting.
The public-coverage evidence is secondary reporting; the experimental evidence is primary.

evidence.explanation: This contemporary article discusses separate public demonstrations involving illegal moves. It supports the reputation component; its humorous wording is not treated as a technical explanation.

A 19-game GPT-3.5 experiment reported successful legal play when the complete move sequence was supplied each turn. It also acknowledged occasional illegal moves, so it limits generalization without disproving the documented reputation.
